version.value: Fourth movement of Symphony No. 2, with orchestral accompaniment
version.note: This file comes from a complete symphony performance. Its performing score edition is not identified.

performers.note: The alto soloist is not named in the consulted Commons or Archive records. Barbara Schubert is the conductor, not the singer.

composition.note: Gustav Mahler died in 1911. This assessment concerns the original composition, not a later edition, arrangement or this recording; it is not a worldwide rights clearance.

recording.note: The upstream notes also request recognition of soloists, conductor and orchestra. That request is preserved in the credit; the singer’s name is unavailable in the consulted records. No independent review of the performers’ releases has been made.

rights.creditLine: Gustav Mahler: Symphony No. 2, IV. Urlicht — Barbara Schubert, conductor; DuPage Symphony Orchestra; alto soloist unidentified in the source. Recorded by Eric Pancer, 22 May 2004, Edman Memorial Chapel. Internet Archive source via Wikimedia Commons, where the file is marked CC0.
